column1: # OWASP ZAP API scan rules for scripts/zap-scan.sh. See baseline-rules.tsv.

column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content) The scan also reaches the static scripts on the same origin.
(CSP script-src unsafe-inline) The scan also reaches the web pages on the same origin. A known gap in docs/security.md.
(Unexpected Content-Type) The API shares its origin with the web app, so paths outside /api are HTML pages by design.
